resources.string: PowerMenu Helper
PowerMenu Helper Service

PowerMenu Helper needs accessibility access solely to invoke system global actions on your behalf: opening the power menu (power off / restart) and locking the screen. It does NOT observe, collect or transmit any screen content. The service reads no events and stores nothing.

Seeing “Restricted setting”?

On Android 13+, an app installed from an APK file (not from an app store) cannot turn on accessibility until you allow it once — the switch stays greyed out. This is a system policy based on how the app was installed, and it affects all such apps. Fix: ① tap the button below to open this app’s App Info page; ② tap the ⋮ menu in the top-right corner; ③ tap “Allow restricted settings” and authenticate; ④ go back and enable the accessibility service. On Xiaomi/MIUI, if there is no ⋮ menu: open this app once, swipe it away from Recents, then long-press its icon → App info, and the menu appears. MIUI also shows a warning with a countdown when you turn the service on — wait for the timer to finish, then confirm. If a pop-up complains that another app is overlapping, temporarily switch from full-screen gestures to button navigation, enable the service, then switch back.

Can’t enable accessibility? Lock screen still works

Activate the device admin (force-lock only) below and the “Lock Screen” button works immediately — no accessibility needed. If accessibility is later enabled, power menu / restart will work too. To uninstall the app afterwards, deactivate the device admin in system settings first.
Activate Device Admin (for one-tap lock)
PowerMenu Helper uses this policy only to lock the screen when you tap “Lock Screen”. Nothing else.
Lock needs either the accessibility service or device admin enabled first.
Reduce the load on your physical power button
Open the default system power menu to power off or restart — no more long-pressing the side key.
One tap to lock the screen, saving wear on the button.
Add the “Power Menu” tile to Quick Settings and trigger it from any screen.
How to enable
1. On Android 13+, if the service switch is greyed out, first allow restricted settings using the card above.
2. Tap “Enable Accessibility Service”, find PowerMenu Helper and turn it on (on MIUI: Settings → Additional settings → Accessibility → Installed apps).
3. Come back and tap the buttons. Done. On MIUI, also turn on Autostart and set Battery saver → No restrictions for this app so the service stays on.
Privacy

This app works fully offline, has no internet permission, shows no ads and collects no data. The accessibility service is used only to perform global actions (power dialog / lock screen) at your request.
